messages:
zoe: Quick UX pass on 'nocturne' dark theme. Main issues: tiny chart lines disappear at thumbnail size, inline code blends with card bg, and the theme toggle copy is ambiguous. Screenshot: https://mock.link/nocturne :eyes:
liam: Noted. For charts I'd suggest adding a 1px stroke to primary lines and increasing mid-tone brightness. Current gradient midpoint at 50% makes midrange colors muddy.
tara: Code blocks need more padding (8px -> 12px) and slightly lighter bg. Proposed vars: --code-bg: #0e1b2b, --code-text: #e8f3ff. That should hit ~7:1 for small snippets.
zoe: Toggle copy: change tooltip from 'Low-power mode' to 'Reduced motion & contrast options' and make the toggle icon-only with accessible hidden label.
design-bot: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/498 (nocturne: contrast + copy tweaks). CI: 2 visual diffs (chart snapshots).
liam: Experiment: move gradient midpoint to 30% and desaturate fill by 10%. That keeps peaks strong but brightens midtones. I'll prototype in storybook.
tara: Accessibility: add an opt-in "High contrast charts" switch under Settings -> Accessibility (default off). Helpful for testing and demos.
zoe: Action items: liam prototype gradient change; tara update code spacing & copy; zoe to run full contrast audit once PR lands. Aim for staging deploy tomorrow.
